title: Flow cards file
description: Schema for data/<id>.cards.yaml — per-node card content merged onto the Mermaid topology by backend/flow_store.py (_merge_cards). Card keys MUST match node ids declared in the matching <id>.flow.mmd; cards with no matching node are silently dropped. Lenient: unknown keys are allowed (the parser ignores them).

flow.description: Flow-level metadata. Note: `id` here is cosmetic — the real flow id is the filename. `name`/`subtitle` populate the navigator label and header.

cards.description: Map keyed by node id. Each key must match an id in <id>.flow.mmd.

propertyNames.description: Node id — matches the Mermaid node id regex ([A-Za-z0-9_]+).

card.description: Content for a single node. Only owner/team/sla/desc/subflow/inputs/outputs/steps/documents/links/pos are read by the parser.

owner.description: Role or system that owns the step (e.g. "Decision Engine"). Skipped on null.

team.description: Owning team (e.g. "Risk Platform"). Skipped on null.

sla.description: Free-text SLA, e.g. "Instant", "< 2 min", "2 business days", "Interactive", "—". Not an enum.

subflow.description: Id of a child flow to drill into. The child must have its own <id>.flow.mmd / .cards.yaml and be registered under this node's parent `children:` in index.yaml.

inputs.description: What the step consumes. Ignored if empty.

outputs.description: What the step produces. Ignored if empty.

steps.description: Sub-actions inside the step (typically 2-3). Ignored if empty.

documents.description: Artifacts the step produces, rendered as tappable chips. Each item is a bare string or a {name,format,status,link} object (normalized by _normalize_docs). Always reset from the card (absent = []).

links.description: Reference material. Each item is a bare URL string or a {label,url} object (normalized by _normalize_links). Always reset from the card (absent = []).

document.description: Bare name string, or an object. _normalize_docs accepts name|title, format|type, link|url; an item with no resolvable name is dropped.

format.description: Free-text format/type, e.g. PDF, JSON, YAML, ZIP, Markdown, Feature, HTML. Alias: type.

status.description: Free-text status, e.g. Generated, Signed off, Published, Issued.

link.description: URL to the artifact. Alias: url.
Bare URL string, or an object. _normalize_links accepts label|title|url, url|href; an item with no resolvable url is dropped.

label.description: Display label. Aliases: title, then url.

pos.description: Pins the node to the layout grid. Both col and lane are required — a partial pos is ignored and the node is auto-placed by layout.js.

col.description: Grid column (× COLW px), left-to-right step order. Some flows use doubled even columns (0,2,4,…) to widen spacing.

lane.description: Grid row. Convention: 0 = main spine, negative = branch above, positive = branch below (declined/fail terminals on a low lane).
